title: Updates
lead: Version, available releases, installation and history. Nothing is installed without your approval.
privacy: Checking for updates is a plain HTTPS request to the configured release source with a generic User-Agent containing only the version. No telemetry, no identifiers.

check.none: You are running the newest version.

source.label: Release source
source.off_text: No release source is configured, so HostingOS does not contact any server. Set HOS_UPDATE_REPO (GitHub owner/name) or HOS_UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL and restart. See docs/UPDATES.md.

keys.label: Signing keys
keys.none_title: No release signing key is trusted yet
keys.none_text: This build contains no public key, so updates can be found and announced but not installed. Releases are shown as unverified until a build with the project's public key is installed.

problems.title: Some releases were rejected.
problems.text: They are not offered for installation.

releases.title: Available versions
releases.hint: Newer than the running version, newest first.
releases.none_text: No newer version has been found.

release.unverified_hint: The signature of this release could not be verified, so it cannot be installed from here.
release.untrusted_notes: Unsigned release: its notes and link come straight from the release source and are shown as plain text. Check them on the project page you know before acting on them.
release.restore_hint: Its database changes are not rollback-safe: going back to the previous version later needs the backup taken before the update.

apply.confirm: Install version {version} now? The site is in maintenance mode for a few minutes.
apply.what: Downloads and verifies the release, turns maintenance mode on, waits for running jobs, takes a backup, swaps the binary (keeping the previous one), runs migrations and restarts. If the new version is not healthy it is rolled back automatically.
apply.no_2fa: Tip: turn on two-factor authentication for your account; installs then also ask for a code.
apply.reauth_failed: Password or authentication code is wrong.
apply.no_keys: This build trusts no signing key, so it cannot install updates.
apply.no_supervisor: HostingOS is not running under a service manager (systemd) that restarts it, so it cannot update itself.
apply.unknown_install: The installation type could not be determined.
apply.unavailable: In-place installation is not available here.
apply.manual: Follow the steps in docs/UPDATES.md to update manually.

backup.label: Backup before updating
backup.command: The configured backup command runs before the update.
backup.pg_dump: A pg_dump backup of the database is taken before the update.
backup.manual: No automatic backup is configured (neither HOS_UPDATE_BACKUP_COMMAND nor pg_dump is available). Take a database backup first.
backup.confirm: I have a current backup of the database

container.text: This installation runs in a container, which never replaces itself. Pull the new image and recreate the container:

deploy.confirm: Call the deploy webhook for version {version}?
deploy.no_webhook: Set a deploy webhook (Coolify, Portainer, CI) in the settings to start deployments from here.

install.title: This installation
install.label: Installation
install.binary_unsupervised: Install in {root}, without a service manager
install.container_detail: Updated by pulling a new image.

settings.title: Settings
settings.auto_check: Check for updates once a day
settings.notify_email_hint: Optional. Receives a message when a new version is found.
settings.webhook_hint: For container installations: called over HTTPS when you trigger a deployment.
settings.secret_set: A secret is stored (encrypted). Leave empty to keep it.
settings.secret_host: The stored secret is removed when the webhook moves to another host.
settings.reauth_hint: Needed when you change the channel or the deploy webhook (address, method or secret).
settings.reauth_required: Changing the channel or the deploy webhook needs your password (and your two-factor code when it is on). Nothing was saved.

run.title: Update {from} → {to}
run.live: This page updates itself, also while the service restarts.
run.restarting_hint: The new version is starting. It must report healthy within the health timeout, otherwise the previous version is restored automatically.
run.rolled_back_hint: The previous version is running again. If the update changed the database in a way that is not rollback-safe, restore the backup taken before the update.

banner.security: HostingOS {version} is available and fixes a security issue.

notice.update_rolled_back: The update to {version} was rolled back.

maintenance.on_hint: Visitors and clients see a maintenance page; the job worker is paused.

error_kind.not_newer: Not newer than the running version
error_kind.not_upgradable: Cannot upgrade directly from this version
error_kind.smoke_test: The new binary did not start
